_doc: Master registry of PoE1 crafting mechanics. 'status' is one of: implemented_verified, implemented_partially_verified, experimental, discovered_not_implemented, unsupported, outdated, removed, unknown. Nothing is 'implemented_verified' until it has passed reference cases cross-checked against an independent tool or in-game test (see TESTING.md). 'verified_for_patch' is the patch whose rules this registry was last reviewed against; if the imported game data is a newer major.minor patch, the app shows a warning and flags all recommendations.

mechanics.name: Mod pools and spawn weights (which mods can roll, tiers, item-level gates, weights)
mechanics.notes: Cross-checked 2026-11-26 against Craft of Exile's data (scripts/compare_craftofexile.py): 10 bases x item level 30/68/86 = 30 reference cases; 29 identical tier by tier (presence, required level, weight). Only difference: wand local mana leech (CoE 1000, ours 500 = spawn 1000 x the data's 50% wand generation weight, which CoE applies to the matching life-leech mod but not to mana leech). CoE also rounds 12.5 weights down to 12 (<0.01% effect). Influence pools not yet cross-checked.

mechanics.name: Orb of Transmutation
mechanics.notes: 1 vs 2 mod split is a placeholder assumption (assumptions.json: magic_mod_count).

mechanics.name: Orb of Alteration
mechanics.notes: Same 1/2 mod placeholder as Transmutation.

mechanics.name: Orb of Alchemy
mechanics.notes: Mod count 4/5/6 = 8:3:1 (community-measured).

mechanics.name: Chaos Orb
mechanics.notes: Mod count 4/5/6 = 8:3:1 (community-measured). Interaction with prefix/suffix lock modelled as: locked side kept, total count drawn from the same distribution.

mechanics.name: Orb of Annulment
mechanics.notes: Uniform over removable explicit mods; fractured and metamod-locked mods are protected.

mechanics.name: Orb of Scouring
mechanics.notes: Rarity after scouring an item that keeps fractured mods is UNVERIFIED (engine keeps rarity).

mechanics.name: Divine Orb
mechanics.notes: Rerolls explicit values uniformly within each stat range; fractured values kept.

mechanics.name: Blessed Orb
mechanics.notes: Implicit values are not modelled yet.

mechanics.name: Vaal Orb / corruption
mechanics.notes: Corrupted items are rejected by every action (correct), but corruption outcomes are not modelled.

mechanics.name: Double corruption (Vaal temple / Altar)
mechanics.notes: Availability in 3.30 must be verified.

mechanics.name: Essences (Whispering to Deafening)
mechanics.notes: Forced mod + rare reforge from game data. 'Shrieking/Deafening can reforge rares' encoded from community knowledge, needs in-game confirmation for 3.30.

mechanics.name: Fossils + Resonators
mechanics.notes: Weight multipliers by mod tag. Not yet modelled: added/forced mods (Glyphic, Tangled...), mirrored, sockets, quality, corrupted essence chance, 'lucky' rolls.

mechanics.name: Crafting bench: add modifier
mechanics.notes: Validated against bench options present in the imported game data.

mechanics.name: Can have up to 3 Crafted Modifiers
Cannot roll Attack Modifiers
mechanics.notes: Blocks mods carrying the 'attack' mod tag.

mechanics.name: Cannot roll Caster Modifiers
mechanics.notes: Blocks mods carrying the 'caster' mod tag.

mechanics.name: Prefix/Suffix Modifiers cannot be changed
mechanics.notes: Effect modelled. These mods exist in the 3.30 game files but are NOT crafting-bench options in the 3.30 data; how they are obtained in 3.30 is unverified.

mechanics.name: 1 / 2 Prefix (Suffix) Modifier(s) cannot be changed
mechanics.notes: Engine refuses items carrying these rather than guessing.

mechanics.name: Harvest reforges / augments / removes
mechanics.notes: Current 3.30 Harvest crafts must be enumerated from game data first.

mechanics.name: Fracturing Orb
mechanics.notes: Fractured mods ARE modelled (protected from removal) when present on a parsed item.

mechanics.name: Recombinators
mechanics.notes: Availability in 3.30 must be verified.

mechanics.name: Conqueror exalts / Awakener's Orb / Orb of Dominance / Maven's Orb
mechanics.notes: Influence tags already widen the mod pool correctly; the currencies that add influence are not modelled.

mechanics.name: Eldritch implicits, Ichors, Embers, Eldritch Chaos/Exalt/Annul
Cluster jewel crafting
mechanics.notes: Cluster mods depend on enchant + passive count, not modelled yet.

mechanics.name: Regular / abyss jewel crafting
mechanics.notes: Pool and 2+2 affix limit modelled; rare jewel mod count is a placeholder.

mechanics.name: Flask crafting (magic)
mechanics.notes: Transmute/alt/aug pool modelled. Flask enchantments (Enkindling/Instilling), tinctures not modelled.

mechanics.name: Map crafting
mechanics.notes: Out of scope until item crafting is solid.

mechanics.name: 3.30 Covens of Umbra league crafting (if any)
mechanics.notes: Research needed: no 3.30 crafting-specific mechanic has been verified yet.

mechanics.name: Scarabs (replaced by Threads in 3.30)
mechanics.notes: Not a crafting mechanic; listed so old strategies relying on scarab-driven farming are flagged.
